history.q: The storming of the Bastille, a key moment of the French Revolution, happened in which year?
history.explain: The Bastille fell on 14 July 1789; the date is now France's national day.

history.q: Napoleon Bonaparte was finally defeated at Waterloo, in which present-day country?
history.explain: Waterloo is just south of Brussels.

history.q: The Normandy landings of the Second World War began on which date?

culture.q: Which Paris museum displays Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa?
culture.explain: It has hung in the Louvre since the Revolution, apart from wartime and its 1911 theft.

culture.q: The Eiffel Tower was built for which event?
options: The end of the First World War
culture.explain: It was the entrance arch to the 1889 Exposition Universelle.

culture.q: What is the official language of France?
culture.explain: Regional languages such as Breton and Occitan are still spoken, but French is the sole official language.
